summary: Combines, converts, and outputs transform channels across Euler, quaternion, matrix, and look-at workflows, including per-input operations and final transform controls.
key_concepts: Transform CHOP converts and combines transform channel sets across Euler, quaternion, matrix, and position output formats.
Channel suffixes define input transform format, and multiple transform sets are matched by prefix and order.
Missing translate and rotate values default to 0, missing scale values default to 1, and missing quaternion values default to identity.
Matrix inputs require complete 3x3 or 4x4 channel sets and use column-major ordering.
Input combination happens before the Transform page combination, and the first input controls output sample count.
Output controls can change transform format, unmatched-channel handling, output order, rotation continuity, and hint vectors.

key_params.name: xformmatrixop
key_params.note: Optional matrix source from Matrix, CHOP, or DAT

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Output format: transform, quaternion transform, matrix, matrix 3x3, or position

key_params.name: unmatchedchans
key_params.note: Warn, ignore, or delete unmatched channels

key_params.name: continuousrotations
key_params.note: Keep Euler rotations continuous using hint information

common_gotchas: Rotation order and transform order materially change the result; copy them from the source system when matching external transforms.
Matrix, quaternion, and Euler channels are not interchangeable without choosing the right output mode.
Look-at and up-vector settings can introduce flips when the target and up vector align.
